# PDF export dependencies

- pdf-lib 1.17.1: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib (MIT)
- @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1: https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit (MIT)
- Noto Sans / Serif / Sans Mono: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/main/hinted/ttf (SIL Open Font License)

Files are bundled locally for offline use. Fonts are subset when embedded in exported PDFs.
Platform system fonts cannot be redistributed; the export uses Noto equivalents and retains the editor line layout. Hand and round styles use Noto Sans.
